content.text: Now let me fix my two test-expectation bugs and re-run everything:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
src = open('tests/test_semantics.py').read()
# o2: to differ in rcode only, the observation must carry the matching answer
old = """         {'id': 'o2', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p', 'result': {
            'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NXDOMAIN', 'answer': []}},"""
new = """         {'id': 'o2', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p', 'result': {
            'status': 'response', 'code': 'unused'}},"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, """         {'id': 'o2', 'query': 'qa', 'profile': 'p', 'result': {
            'status': 'response', 'rcode': 'NXDOMAIN',
            'answer': [r('a.test.', 'AAAA', '2001:db8::1')]}},""")
old = """  {'id': 'o2', 'verdict': 'divergence', 'different': ['rcode']},"""
assert old in src
# V10: add the wildcard record so that rfc/off actually differ
old_v10 = "{'origin': 'off.test.', 'records': [r('x.off.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')]}]"
assert old_v10 in src
src = src.replace(old_v10,
    "{'origin': 'off.test.', 'records': [r('x.off.test.', 'TXT', 'e'), r('*.off.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')]}")
old = """  run_of('q2', 'pa', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'q.off.test.',
         [('q.off.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')], ['q.off.test.']),"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, """  run_of('q2', 'pa', 'NOERROR', 'ANSWER', 'q.off.test.',
         [('q.off.test.', 'A', '192.0.2.3')], ['q.off.test.']),
  run_of('q2x', 'pa', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', '', [], []),""")
src = src.replace("""  run_of('q2', 'pc', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', 'q.off.test.', [], ['q.off.test.']),""",
"""  run_of('q2', 'pc', 'NXDOMAIN', 'NXDOMAIN', 'q.off.test.', [], ['q.off.test.']),""")
src = src.replace("""  run_of('q2x', 'pa', 'NOERROR', 'NODATA', '', [], []),""", "")
open('tests/test_semantics.py','w').write(src)
print('ok')
PYEOF
python3 tests/test_semantics.py; echo "exit=$?"; python3 tests/test_invalid.py; echo "exit=$?"
